meta.title: Engrammatic Eclipse - Memory Bond - De Lacey

units.rawText: Professor, are you okay? Did Sangoma do something? I heard you needed help, so I'm getting the records organized and sent to you ASAP!
units.displayText: Professor, are you okay? Did Sangoma do something? I heard you needed help, so I'm getting the records organized and sent to you ASAP!

spans.text: Professor, are you okay? Did Sangoma do something? I heard you needed help, so I'm getting the records organized and sent to you ASAP!

units.rawText: I've gone through Rossum, Helios... and every other sector you've visited in Magrasea to compile the records you might need, Professor.
units.displayText: I've gone through Rossum, Helios... and every other sector you've visited in Magrasea to compile the records you might need, Professor.

spans.text: I've gone through Rossum, Helios... and every other sector you've visited in Magrasea to compile the records you might need, Professor.

units.rawText: Oh, right. It also includes the records of when we first met in the Copley Sector! Ah, I also asked Hatsuchiri to include hers.
units.displayText: Oh, right. It also includes the records of when we first met in the Copley Sector! Ah, I also asked Hatsuchiri to include hers.

units.rawText: Thank you, De Lacey. That's incredibly thorough.
units.displayText: Thank you, De Lacey. That's incredibly thorough.

spans.text: Thank you, De Lacey. That's incredibly thorough.

units.rawText: Hehehe, I'm just happy to help you~
units.displayText: Hehehe, I'm just happy to help you~

spans.text: Hehehe, I'm just happy to help you~

units.rawText: Every time I review those records, I find myself even more impressed by you, Professor. Whether it's coming to Magrasea alone or building the Oasis piece by piece, you've turned the impossible into reality with your own hands.

units.rawText: I had so much I wanted to say when I first met you, but I was too nervous, and the circumstances didn't really allow for much conversation... Thinking about it now, it feels like such a shame~
units.displayText: I had so much I wanted to say when I first met you, but I was too nervous, and the circumstances didn't really allow for much conversation... Thinking about it now, it feels like such a shame~

units.rawText: Indeed. When we first met, we were still busy with Demiurge, and I remember you bit your tongue back there.

spans.text: Indeed. When we first met, we were still busy with Demiurge, and I remember you bit your tongue back there.

units.rawText: Ahhh! P-Professor, you really don't need to recall such details! Oh no, should I be happy that you remember our first meeting, or should I feel embarrassed about it? AAAHHH!
units.displayText: Ahhh! P-Professor, you really don't need to recall such details! Oh no, should I be happy that you remember our first meeting, or should I feel embarrassed about it? AAAHHH!

units.rawText: Hah... hah... hah... I'm sorry for showing you this embarrassing side of me again, Professor.

spans.text: Hah... hah... hah... I'm sorry for showing you this embarrassing side of me again, Professor.

units.rawText: Professor, besides helping with your memory recovery, there's something else I need to say for this communication. Even though I... we aren't at the Oasis, our convictions are the same. I truly believe you'll save Magrasea and take us back to the real world.
